messages.subject: Trajectory ID
parts:
Is it possible to get the trajectory ID or number of its generation from within a trajectory?

We're looking at things like random streams for each trajectory, or latin cube/Halton attribute designs. To assign the attributes each trajectory from a generator needs a unique number (preferably sequential). I see this in the output summaries, but need access to it when setting attributes.

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Trajectory ID
parts: Each generator assigns a sequential number to each generated arrival, but this number is not accessible right now. Nevertheless, you can put a set_attribute() at the beginning of the trajectory and assign your own identifier, right?

parts: > Nevertheless, you can put a set_attribute() at the beginning of the trajectory and assign your own identifier, right?
But how would I know that I'm not assigning something another trajectory has? If I use a global counter variable is there a race condition? Or is this all single threaded?

messages.author: 0f5b7adb7e70bd8b
messages.subject: Re: [simmer-devel] Re: Trajectory ID
parts: Yes, it is single-threaded. There is no possible race condition.
